Itemized Passive Description:
*Activates the Entrance Animation when there is another
"Demonic Power" or "Battle of Wits" Category ally on the team
upon the character's entry*
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- {passiveImg:once}{passiveImg:forever}Damage reduction rate 40%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Basic effect(s)*
- ATK & DEF 250%{passiveImg:up_g}
- All allies' Ki +2 (self excluded)
- ATK & DEF 40%{passiveImg:up_g} and damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g} for the
character and allies whose names include "Majin Kuu" or "Majin Duu"
*When attacking with 11 or less Ki*
- Launches 2 additional attacks, each of which has a great chance
of becoming a Super Attack
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Guards all attacks
- Damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Before attacking*
- Great chance of evading enemy's attack
- Damage reduction rate 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack*
- DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When 3 or more Extreme Class allies are on the team*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 20%{passiveImg:up_g} before attacking
*Per "Mission Execution" or "Siblings' Bond" Category ally on
the team (depending on which Category has more members)*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking (up to 400%)
*As the 1st attacker in a turn*
- ATK 300%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every attack received or evaded*
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 200%)
*Starting from the 5th turn from the character's entry turn*
- {passiveImg:once}"Demonic Power" Category allies' ATK 20%{passiveImg:up_g} for 2 turns
when attacking
